## Module Objectives

At the end of this module, you should be able to:

- Fit and interpret a simple linear regression model.
- Use a simple linear regression model to obtain predictions.
- Fit and interpret a multiple linear regression model.
- Recognize and discuss potential biases, particularly those related to discrimination, in data or models.

<p>You must produce a <strong>180-second video capsule</strong> in which you present:</p>

<li>either a predictive model built in Mission 1;</li>
<li>or a critical analysis of a bias detected in Mission 2.</li>
</ul>
<p>The capsule must include:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>a clear introduction;</p></li>
<li><p>a brief methodology;</p></li>
<li><p>visual results (graphs, tables);</p></li>
<li><p>a conclusion with at least one recommendation.</p></li>
